svg.text: 1. Operation definitions differ by design (bare createIdentity vs VIN-bound mintVehicle); the reconciliation is in MEASUREMENT_CONDITIONS #6/#25: ≈10× bare,

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: ≈7× when the VIN is bound on both sides (createVehicleDID 78,068).

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 2. Over a full MOBI VID lifecycle (#30) the minimal registry is cheapest by 2.58× (vs ERC-721) and 3.00× (vs ERC-725), not ≈10×; H1's restatement is the

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 3. ERC-4337 EntryPoint and LSP8 are minimal representatives (lower bounds). MOBI-VID-V2 is an application profile. Fiat is a parameter and is not drawn.
